comment: Provenance and SHA-256 hashes of every creature's ORIGINAL 34-byte record, written by tools/import/step_sectors.py (import_all.py) from the raw foe buffer named under "source" (NEP.DLL, saved by tools/extract/extract_data.py from your copy of the game; extracted/tables/sectors.json, from tools/analysis/export_json.py, carries where it comes from), never hand-edited. It holds no original bytes: creature k of a sector is the "size" bytes at "offset" of its buffer (1 + 34 * k: the buffer starts with the count byte), "sha256" the hash of the whole record. godot/tests/legacy/test_foe_record_fidelity.gd checks that SectorData.encode_foe_records() hashes to these. The record bytes themselves are written to the git-ignored tests/fixtures/original/foe_records.json by the same importer run, for first-difference messages. See docs/port/FIDELITY.md, "Fixtures commit hashes, not bytes".
